description: This file defines build rules and device configurations for a Linux embedded system, including image creation, boot scripts, device-specific parameters, and build procedures.

methods.name: Build/boot-scr
methods.description: Creates a boot script image using mkimage for ARM64 Linux systems.

methods.name: Build/boot-img-ext4
methods.description: Builds an ext4 filesystem image for boot with kernel and device tree overlays.

methods.name: Build/sdcard-img-ext4
methods.description: Generates an ext4 image suitable for SD card installation, including partitioning and padding.

methods.name: Device/Default
methods.description: Defines default device parameters such as profiles, filesystems, and kernel settings.

methods.name: Device/imx8m
methods.description: Specifies device-specific parameters for the NXP i.MX8M device, including device tree source files.

methods.name: Device/gateworks_venice
methods.description: Overrides default device settings for the Gateworks Venice platform, including supported device models, device trees, packages, and images.
